chapters.title: Counts: checking the stock on the shelves
chapters.text: This is Counts, where stock counts are recorded, to check that what is on the shelf matches the records. Every count is listed, newest first.

chapters.title: Tap + Manual Count
chapters.text: To record a count, tap plus Manual Count.

chapters.title: Search the item and tap it
chapters.text: Search for the item you counted, and tap it.

chapters.title: Count them on the shelf. Type the number
chapters.text: Count the item on the shelf, and type the number you counted. Add a note if there is something to explain.

chapters.title: Tap Save
chapters.text: Then tap Save. If your count is lower than the records expect, the app will ask why, so always give the real reason.

chapters.title: History: every count ever made
chapters.text: History lists every count ever made, and who made it.

chapters.title: Law: COUNT NOW items are counted every day
chapters.text: Company law: the items marked COUNT NOW are counted every day, and their warning banners cleared. Counts are separate from flags: the manager records at least ten counts a day.

chapters.title: The laws and this video: 📜 Laws
chapters.text: Breaking a law costs penalty points, and the owner approves every sanction. The laws of this page, and this video, are on the Laws button.
